title: Wonderful 🤩
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A wonderful and totally recommended experience!

The guided tour of the Alhambra, the Alcazaba, and the Generalife was spectacular, but without a doubt the best part was our guide, Diana. An exceptional professional, charming, approachable, and very kind, who goes far beyond her duties so that everyone enjoys the experience to the fullest. Your dedication, your knowledge, and your way of conveying history made the visit even more special. A real luxury to have her! Thank you so much, Diana, for your affection and professionalism. A 10 is not enough! ❤️
author: patriciatC771PM

title: Nice guide
text: Good guide, clearly understandable with headphones, it would be nicer if the group were a bit smaller as it is a bit more personal
